extracted.name: Instant Pot Sauerkraut
extracted.description: Make sauerkraut in your Instant Pot in less than an hour with this easy recipe and just 4 ingredients: cabbage, vinegar, salt, and water!
instruction_lines: Place cabbage in the pot of a multi-functional electric pressure cooker. Add vinegar, water, and salt. Stir and cover.
Lock the lid, close the vent, and select Chicken/Meat setting according to manufacturer’s instructions. Set timer for 15 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.
Release pressure using the natural-release method according to manufacturer’s instructions, 10 to 40 minutes.
